newsitem.title: USA: New Mexico Four Corners 750 MW coal unit back up.
newsitem.headline: New Mexico Four Corners 750 MW coal unit back up.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 5 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in New Mexico was restarted Monday morning, as expected, after being shut Thursday night for maintenance work, the plant's manager said.
Four Corners' 185 MW unit 1 was still scheduled to restart around 0600 MT on Tuesday, after also being taken out of service Thursday night, he noted.
Four Corners' other 750 MW, other 185 MW and 245 MW units were said to be operating normally.

Arizona Public Service Co, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital, operates Four Corners and owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5. Edison International's Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake in units 4 and 5.
